# oh-my-claudecode v5.6.1: Maintenance Release

## Release Notes

Maintenance release with internal improvements.

### Stats

- **1 PR merged** | **0 new features** | **0 bug fixes** | **0 security/hardening improvements** | **0 other changes**

### Install / Update

The npm CLI and the Claude Code marketplace/plugin are separate install tracks, not either/or replacements. Update whichever track you use; if you have both installed, update both. CLI-dependent skill paths such as `ask` and CLI-backed `team` require the `omc` CLI from the npm package.

**CLI / runtime:**

```bash
npm install -g oh-my-claude-sisyphus@5.6.1
```

**Claude Code plugin:**

```text
/plugin marketplace update omc
```

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-claudecode/compare/v5.6.0...v5.6.1
